Sales Quote — Edit

The Sales Quote form allows you to create professional quotations for potential customers, presenting your products or services with pricing and terms before they commit to a purchase.

Sales quotes are essential business documents that help you communicate your offerings clearly, establish pricing expectations, and provide a foundation for future sales orders or invoices.

Purpose and Benefits

Sales quotes serve as non-binding proposals that can be revised based on customer feedback. They help you:

• Present a professional image to potential customers

• Clearly communicate pricing and terms

• Create a paper trail for negotiations

• Provide a foundation for converting accepted quotes into Sales Orders or Sales Invoices

Creating a Sales Quote

When creating a sales quote, ensure all details are accurate and complete. Key features include:

• Link quotes to specific customers to automatically populate their details

• Set expiry dates to create urgency and manage quote validity

• Include detailed line items with quantities, unit prices, and applicable tax codes

• Add custom fields to capture additional information specific to your business needs

Once a customer accepts your quote, you can easily convert it to a Sales Order or Sales Invoice without re-entering data.

Form Fields

This form contains the following fields:

Issue date

Enter the date when this quote was issued to the customer.

Expiry date

Enter the number of days this quote remains valid. After this period, the quoted prices may no longer apply.

Reference

Enter a reference number for this quote. This helps track and identify quotes when communicating with customers.

Customer

Select the customer or prospect who will receive this quote. Their billing address will automatically populate.

Billing address

Enter the customer's billing address. This is automatically filled from the customer record but can be modified for this quote.

Description

Optionally, add a description, introduction, or notes about this quote. This appears at the top of the quote document.

Lines

Enter the products or services being quoted. Each line includes item details, quantities, prices, and descriptions.

Amounts are tax inclusive

Check this box if the prices you enter already include tax. Leave unchecked if you want tax calculated on top of the entered prices.

Rounding

Check this box to enable rounding of the total amount. This is useful when you want to quote round numbers.

RoundingMethod

Select how to round the total amount - to the nearest whole number, nearest 10, nearest 100, etc.

Column — Line number

Check this box to display line numbers on the quote. This helps when discussing specific items with customers.

Column — Discount

Check this box to enable a discount column where you can offer line-item discounts.

DiscountType

Select whether discounts are entered as percentages or fixed amounts.

Hide total amount

Check this box to hide the total amount on the printed quote. Useful for quotes where you only want to show unit prices.

Cancelled

This indicates whether the quote has been cancelled. Cancelled quotes remain in the system for record-keeping but are marked as inactive.
